facts.label: Perguntas indiretas com what e which
facts.sub: Depois de I’m not sure, Do you know e Can you tell me, use what ou which + sujeito + verbo: I’m not sure what it costs. Do you know which one is fresh?

facts.label: O que
facts.sub: Use what para perguntar sobre uma informação desconhecida: I’m not sure what it costs. Do you know what you want? Depois de what, a ordem é a da frase afirmativa: what it costs.

facts.label: Qual
facts.sub: Use which quando há uma escolha entre coisas conhecidas: Do you know which one is fresh? Which apples are best? Which + substantivo é muito comum em mercados.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I’m not sure what it costs is correct.
We say “I’m not sure what does it cost.”
Which is used for a choice between things.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I’m not sure what it costs is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I’m not sure what does it cost.” → Falso (We say what it costs.)
Which is used for a choice between things. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A busy market · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Saturday at the central market in Adelaide. The smell of fresh bread fills the air. Jo works at a fruit and cheese stall. She greets every customer with a smile. Leo comes with an empty basket. He is not sure what to buy.

“Good morning, Leo! What would you like today?” says Jo. “Hi, Jo. I’m not sure what I need. Do you know what apples are best?” says Leo. “I can tell you which ones are fresh. These green ones are from this morning.” says Jo.
